_catatan: Angka Awakening yang tidak ada di data game (tampil sebagai X). Disalin dari layar Awaken di dalam game. Nomor 7 dan 8 = bonus 3 dan 6 Awakening. Dipakai build.py agar tidak tertimpa saat data dibuat ulang.

1.en: Increases Exe's Chaos DMG by 20% while his Rating is SS or higher.
1.id: Meningkatkan Chaos DMG Exe sebesar 20% selama Rating-nya SS atau lebih tinggi.

3.en: Causes Data Exfiltration to pull in enemies within range and reduce their Chaos Resistance by 15% for 12s.
3.id: Data Exfiltration menarik musuh dalam jangkauan dan mengurangi Chaos Resistance mereka sebesar 15% selama 12 detik.

4.en: Increases DMG dealt by summons on the field by 10%. Digital Echoes gain an additional 30% DMG Bonus.
4.id: Meningkatkan DMG yang diberikan summon di medan sebesar 10%. Digital Echo mendapat tambahan DMG Bonus 30%.

5.en: Causes Digital Echoes to release a shockwave when they vanish while Shader Compile from Exe's Ultimate is active. Each shockwave deals additional DMG equal to 25.8% of ATK to targets in range. The DMG Ratio of Digital Echoes scales with the Basic Attack skill level.
5.id: Selama Shader Compile dari Ultimate Exe aktif, Digital Echo melepaskan gelombang kejut saat menghilang. Setiap gelombang kejut memberikan DMG tambahan sebesar 25,8% ATK ke target dalam jangkauan. DMG Ratio Digital Echo mengikuti level skill Basic Attack.

7.en: Increases the skill levels of Basic Attack, Redirect Skill, and Ultimate by 1. Increases Charge Efficiency by 25%. Prevents Rating from decreasing for the rest of the battle.
7.id: Meningkatkan level skill Basic Attack, Redirect Skill, dan Ultimate sebesar 1. Meningkatkan Charge Efficiency sebesar 25%. Rating tidak akan turun sampai pertarungan berakhir.

8.en: Increases Rating gain rate and Resistance to Interruptions by 50%. Unlocks Ω Rating. While at Ω Rating, Exe accumulates Frames faster, and Awaken: define X/Y is modified to grant him an additional 50% ATK. Allows Network Penetration to also execute Boss targets with less than 5% HP while Shader Compile from Exe's Ultimate is active.
8.id: Meningkatkan laju perolehan Rating dan Resistance to Interruptions sebesar 50%. Membuka Rating Ω. Selama Rating Ω, Exe mengumpulkan Frame lebih cepat, dan Awaken: define X/Y diubah sehingga ia mendapat tambahan 50% ATK. Selama Shader Compile dari Ultimate Exe aktif, Network Penetration juga bisa mengeksekusi target Boss dengan HP di bawah 5%.
